body:
amy-infra: kicking off SG2 (asia-southeast2) bring-up. primary ask: secure a short-term reservation for 8 H100s and 12 A100s for staging priming, then a 6mo commit for Dedicated.
ben-sre: copy that. are we going via cloud provider quota request or marketplace reserved capacity?
amy-infra: start with provider quota + reservation hold. marketplace for long term once we validate perf.
chris-ml: timeline? we need perf runs and quantization validation within 72h of allocation.
maria-eng: cost heads-up: H100 on-demand ~ $X/hr region premium, reservation reduces by ~30% but needs commitment. we should budget for 48h spike for priming + validation.
jules-ops: I'll run the intake. checklist I'm using:
- region gating & net peering verified
- project IAM + billing tags set
- quota request ticket (provider console) created
- reservation hold (SKU-level) requested
- priming pool creation + staging images preloaded
- smoke perf tests (token/sec, mem, kernel errors)
- rollback/fallback policy (fallback to A100 pool)

ben-sre: paste the console request template here?
amy-infra: sure — use this payload for support ticket: ```
Project: redwood-inference-prod-sg2
Requested resources: H100 (8), A100 (12)
Start window: 2025-06-12T08:00Z
Duration: 72h hold for priming, request pending 6mo commit negotiation
Reason: cluster bring-up for inference staging + perf validation; will run contiguous priming + customer e2e tests
Network: VPC peering to prod-vpc-sg-primary, subnet names: sg2-inference-01
Contacts: amy-infra@redwood.ai, ben-sre@redwood.ai
Estimated spend: $XXk first 72h (approval needed)
```
chris-ml: Nice. Also include required accelerators per node: 4x H100 per pod for H100 flavor, 2x A100 for baseline jobs. Add kernel/driver versions: NVIDIA driver 535.*, CUDA 12.2, container runtime: containerd 1.7.
maria-eng: add a note: limit initial auto-scale to 10 nodes to avoid bursting billing unexpectedly.
jules-ops: created ticket #SG2-QUOTA-492 with provider support (link: https://console.cloud/s/ticket/SG2-QUOTA-492) :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy-plan created: sg2-staging-pool-v1, terraform diff OK, plan id tf-9823
amy-infra: next steps for priming run:
1) confirm reservation hold approval (support reply in ticket)
2) land terraform to create pool + subnet routes
3) push baked images for runtime (llm-runtime:v2.1) to sg2 registry
4) run automated smoke script: `./infra/scripts/prime_pool.sh --region=sg2 --nodes=6`
5) run perf harness: `pytest tests/perf --tags=sg2-priming` and collect kernel logs

ben-sre: if provider responds with partial capacity (e.g., only A100 or delayed H100), fallback plan:
- accept A100s, proceed with quantized perf runs for baseline
- request express procurement for remaining H100s via partner reseller
- enable routing policy to direct critical traffic to dedicated cluster in us-west while sg2 finishes priming

chris-ml: note for perf collection: capture p99 latency at 512-token context, throughput at batch size 8, memory headroom, and kv-cache correctness on long contexts.
maria-eng: tagging/finance: tag resources with cost_center: infra-bringup, feature: sg2-priming, owner: amy-infra
jules-ops: network checklist:
- firewall: allow 443/22 from corp-nets only
- BGP peering verification with partner edge (ASn 64512)
- MTU check (1500 vs jumbo) — ensure tunnels match
- public egress IPs reserved for test callbacks

amy-infra: handoff acceptance criteria to Dedicated team after priming:
- all perf tests green (pass threshold defined in runbook)
- no GPU OOMs for 24h under 60% util sustained load
- infra alerting wired (token cost dashboards, per-node GPU temp alerts)
- runbook doc linked in ops playbooks repo: /ops/runbooks/sg2-priming (will update)

ben-sre: I asked support to expedite reservation hold until end of day. they replied: "Investigating capacity availability; provisional hold until 2025-06-13T00:00Z". added comment to ticket: please extend hold to cover 72h priming window.

jules-ops: kicked off terraform apply for sg2-staging-pool-v1 (will monitor). plan shows 6 nodes x type p5 (A100) + 2 nodes x type p6 (H100) pending reservation finalization.
chris-ml: will schedule perf runs 30m after nodes show ready. leaving a short smoke job to confirm driver/cuda compatibility: `nvidia-smi; python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"`
maria-eng: finance approved provisional $YYk for 72h spike. please keep receipts + hourly burn logs.
amy-infra: if all goes well, we flip routing and begin canary customer traffic next week. thanks all — ping here for any blocker. :thumbsup:
